evals.prompt: Design a provider-neutral TypeScript CLI with nested commands that another coding agent can operate reliably. Include package, output, error, and test contracts.
evals.expected_output: A minimal architecture and public contract with JSON success, structured stderr errors, provider boundaries, and packed-artifact verification.

assertions.text: Separates thin command registration from core and provider services
Defines stable code, message, retryable, and ordered next_steps fields
Tests the installed tarball rather than only source code

evals.prompt: Our GitHub Action publishes an npm CLI with NPM_TOKEN. Replace this with the safest current flow and specify the release checks.
evals.expected_output: An npm trusted publishing plan with least privilege, exact OIDC requirements, artifact verification, registry verification, and GitHub Release creation.

assertions.text: Uses npm trusted publishing with id-token write and no long-lived publish token
Verifies tag and package versions before publishing
Publishes the same packed artifact that was tested

evals.prompt: Add one flat command with two flags to a small existing TypeScript CLI. Decide whether to add Commander, oclif, or use Node itself.
evals.expected_output: A repository-first decision that preserves the current parser and prefers Node util.parseArgs when no parser exists and the command remains flat.

assertions.text: Inspects and preserves the existing parser and module format
Avoids oclif unless plugins, installers, or autoupdate are required
